headlines.snippet: Iran has dismissed Trump's claims of 'total US control' over the Strait of Hormuz, stating that blocked shipping traffic does not alter the reality of the situation. The Strait remains a point of contention.

headlines.snippet: A report suggests the CIA had low confidence in an Iranian threat before Trump switched planes in Turkey. Doubts about Israeli intelligence regarding the threat prompted the secret flight.
